name: Ink drop
summary: Ink drop falls in, hits and blooms into a soft ink cloud with ripples; for opening reveals and title drops.

params.name: drop
params.note: fall height in px above the impact

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at

params.name: color
params.note: ink colour; default the style ink

author: krakujs
